ProgramUnit.Name: DO_OT_UT_RETRIEVE_PROCESSING
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE do_ot_ut_retrieve_processing IS
 cursor c1 (v_date date) is 
 select staff_no,first_name||' '||last_name name, emp_class, facility_code
 from employees
 where emp_class in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type = 'MANAS'
 and v_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date, v_date +1))
 and emp_class != 'FSTAF'
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and nvl(term_date,:control_block.s_start_date) >= :control_block.s_start_date 
 and schedule_from_date is not null
 and schedule_from_date <= to_date(:control_block.s_end_date,'MM-DD-RR');
 hours number := 0;
 count_rec number := 0 ;
 total_ot_ut number := 0 ;
 tot_hrs varchar2(20);
 v_date date;
BEGIN
 v_date := to_date(:global.v_sysdate, 'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI');
 go_block('OT_UT_BLOCK') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 clear_block ;
 --show_working_message ;
 for c1rec in c1 (v_date) loop
 don_mcal_common.staff_weekly_hours(:staff_schedule_hdr.schedule_id,
 c1rec.staff_no,
 :global.chapter_id,
 tot_hrs);
 hours := (substr(tot_hrs,1, instr(tot_hrs, ':')-1)) *60 + 
 substr(tot_hrs, instr(tot_hrs, ':')+1);
 if hours < (32*60) then
 count_rec := count_rec + 1 ;
 :ot_ut_block.seq_no := count_rec ;
 :ot_ut_block.staff_no := c1rec.staff_no ;
 :ot_ut_block.staff_name := c1rec.name ;
 :ot_ut_block.dummy_tot_hrs := tot_hrs;
 :ot_ut_block.emp_class := c1rec.emp_class;
 :ot_ut_block.facility := c1rec.facility_code;
 :ot_ut_block.total_hours := tot_hrs;
 next_record ;
 end if;
 end loop ;
 SYNCHRONIZE; -- IM:8671 
 first_record;
 go_item('ot_ut_block.decision'); 
 --clear_message ;
 END;

ProgramUnit.Name: RUN_OTHER_FORM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE RUN_OTHER_FORM (p_name in varchar2 , P_type in varchar2 )IS
p_exec_name varchar2(12);
author varchar2(10);
module_name varchar2(200);
mnemonic_name varchar2(8);

BEGIN
 
 if p_type = 'M' then
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select A.exec_name, b.descrip into
 p_exec_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 b.mnemonic = p_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;

 if p_type = 'X' then
 p_exec_name := p_name;
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select b.mnemonic, b.descrip into
 mnemonic_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 a.exec_name = p_exec_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;


 if :global.db_id = 'N/A'
 then
 begin
 select
 decode(substr(global_name,1,1),'W','D',substr(global_name,1,3))
 into :global.db_id
 from global_name;
 exception
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 end if;

 if substr(:global.db_id,1,1) = 'D' Then
 begin
 select Program_author into author from fcn
 where exec_name = p_exec_name ;
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 author := 'ISQA'; 
 End;
 module_name := module_name ||' By '||author;
 end if;

 p_exec_name := p_exec_name ||'.fmx';
 module_name := mnemonic_name ||': '||
 module_name ;
 :global.module_name := module_name;
 CALL_FORM( lower(p_exec_name));
 if form_failure then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
end;
